name: CI
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
          cache: npm
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm test

name: Release

on:
  push:
    tags:
      - "v*"

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  build:
    strategy:
      matrix:
        include:
          - os: macos-latest
            platform: mac
          - os: ubuntu-latest
            platform: linux
          - os: windows-latest
            platform: win
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
          cache: npm

      - name: Cache server dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: server/node_modules
          key: server-deps-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('server/package-lock.json') }}
          restore-keys: server-deps-${{ runner.os }}-

      - name: Install root dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Install server dependencies
        run: cd server && npm ci

      - name: Generate icons
        run: npm run icons

      - name: Build (${{ matrix.platform }})
        run: npm run build:${{ matrix.platform }}
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY: false

      - name: Upload artifacts
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: dist-${{ matrix.platform }}
          path: |
            dist/*.dmg
            dist/*.zip
            dist/*.exe
            dist/*.AppImage
            dist/*.deb
          if-no-files-found: warn

  release:
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Download all artifacts
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          path: artifacts
          merge-multiple: true

      - name: Create GitHub Release
        uses: softprops/action-gh-release@v2
        with:
          draft: true
          generate_release_notes: true
          files: artifacts/*
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

{

  "version": "0.4.0",
  "main": "main.js",
  "bin": {
    "openclawd": "./bin/cli.mjs"
  },

    "bin/",
    "server/*.js",
    "server/*.json",
    "server/providers/",
    "README.md",
    "LICENSE"

    "dev": "NODE_ENV=development electron .",
    "start": "electron .",
    "postinstall": "cd server && npm install",
    "build": "electron-builder",
    "build:mac": "electron-builder --mac",
    "build:win": "electron-builder --win",
    "build:linux": "electron-builder --linux",
    "build:all": "electron-builder -mwl",
    "icons": "electron-icon-builder --input=build/icon.png --output=build",
    "test": "vitest run",
    "test:watch": "vitest",
    "test:coverage": "vitest run --coverage"
  },
  "author": "Rohit Ghumare",
  "license": "MIT",
  "description": "Desktop chat app with 20+ LLM providers and MCP integrations",
  "repository": {
    "type": "git",
    "url": "https://github.com/rohitg00/openclawd.git"
  },
  "dependencies": {
    "@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk": "^0.2.7",
    "@clack/prompts": "^0.11.0",
    "@opencode-ai/sdk": "latest",
    "cors": "^2.8.5",
    "dotenv": "^16.4.5",
    "express": "^5.2.1",
    "picocolors": "^1.1.1"
  },
  "optionalDependencies": {
    "@github/copilot-sdk": "^0.1.13"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "@vitest/coverage-v8": "^4.0.18",
    "electron": "^39.5.1",
    "electron-builder": "^26.7.0",
    "electron-icon-builder": "^2.0.1",
    "electron-reload": "^2.0.0-alpha.1",
    "supertest": "^7.2.2",
    "vitest": "^4.0.18"
  }
}

#!/bin/bash

set -e

echo "OpenClawd Setup"
echo "==============="
echo ""

if [ ! -f .env ]; then
  cp .env.example .env
  echo "Created .env from template"
else
  echo ".env file already exists"
fi
echo ""

echo "LLM Provider Configuration"
echo "--------------------------"
echo "Supported: Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, Venice, Ollama, OpenRouter, Groq, xAI, Mistral, Bedrock, and more"
echo ""
read -p "Enter your Anthropic API key (or press Enter to skip): " api_key
if [ -n "$api_key" ]; then
  if [[ "$OSTYPE" == "darwin"* ]]; then
    sed -i '' "s/ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=.*/ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=$api_key/" .env
  else
    sed -i "s/ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=.*/ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=$api_key/" .env
  fi
  echo "Anthropic API key saved to .env"
else
  echo "Skipped. Add API keys to .env manually."
fi
echo ""

echo "Installing dependencies..."
npm install
cd server && npm install && cd ..
cd messaging && npm install && cd ..
echo ""

echo "========================"
echo "Setup complete!"
echo "========================"
echo ""
echo "Available providers: Run 'curl http://localhost:3001/api/llm/providers' to see configured providers"
echo ""
echo "Next steps:"
echo "  1. Add API keys to .env for providers you want to use"
echo "  2. (Optional) Configure MCP servers in server/mcp-servers.json"
echo "  3. Start backend: cd server && npm start"
echo "  4. Start app: npm start (in another terminal)"
echo ""
echo "For messaging bot (WhatsApp/Telegram/Signal):"
echo "  cd messaging && node cli.js"
echo ""
echo "API Endpoints:"
echo "  GET  /api/llm/providers  - List LLM providers"
echo "  GET  /api/llm/models     - List available models"
echo "  GET  /api/llm/usage      - Usage statistics"
echo "  GET  /api/auth/profiles  - Auth profiles"
echo "  GET  /api/mcp/servers    - MCP servers"
echo "  POST /api/chat           - Chat endpoint"
echo ""
echo "Need help? Open an issue on GitHub!"
echo ""

{

  "_docs": "Browse all available servers at: GET /api/mcp/catalog",
  "_recommended": "Get no-auth servers at: GET /api/mcp/recommended",

  "_section_core": "=== CORE SERVERS (No Auth Required) ===",

    "type": "stdio",
    "command": "npx",
    "args": ["-y", "@modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem", "${HOME}/projects"],
    "enabled": false,
    "_description": "Secure file operations with configurable access controls"

    "command": "npx",
    "args": ["-y", "@modelcontextprotocol/server-memory"],

    "_description": "Knowledge graph-based persistent memory system"
  },

  "fetch": {
    "type": "stdio",
    "command": "npx",
    "args": ["-y", "@modelcontextprotocol/server-fetch"],

    "_description": "Web content fetching and conversion"
  },

  "git": {
    "type": "stdio",
    "command": "npx",
    "args": ["-y", "@modelcontextprotocol/server-git"],
    "enabled": false,
    "_description": "Git repository operations"
  },

  "time": {
    "type": "stdio",
    "command": "npx",
    "args": ["-y", "@modelcontextprotocol/server-time"],
    "enabled": false,
    "_description": "Time and timezone conversion"
  },

  "sequential-thinking": {
    "type": "stdio",
    "command": "npx",

    "type": "stdio",
    "command": "npx",
    "args": ["-y", "@modelcontextprotocol/server-notion"],

    "command": "npx",

  "_section_database": "=== DATABASE ===",

    "enabled": false,

  }
